name: Business Manager
version: v1.0 · 2026-11-15 · Kenya edition of the Business Manager script: Kenyan names, KES prices, M-Pesa/Cash, KRA due dates (app v1.6) · store step: free · +2 steps: Make it mine (22 Nov) · +1 step: keyboard 🎤 (24 Nov)
verified: 2026-11-15 · Business Manager v1.6 · driven twice on a fresh test copy at phone width, all 22 app steps as written
intro:
⚠️ BEFORE STEP 1 — check you are in a test copy. Look for the small “🧪 Test copy” mark on the screen. It means this app has never seen you, which is what the steps below expect. If it is missing and the app already shows your own information, you have opened your real app: go back to your list and tap this app's name again, rather than using a bookmark, your history, or an icon on your home screen. Starting in the wrong copy makes the early steps look broken when nothing is wrong.

You will peek at the example business (Miller Plumbing), then set the app up for a pretend builder, Miller Construction, using the General Construction price list. You add a customer (Linda Hansen), price a garage-framing job, mark it approved, take a deposit, record a lumber bill, add to-dos and tax dates, and check everything is still there after a reload. Never press a 📨 Send or 📞 Call button — they would reach a real person. The last two steps DO ask you to open 💬 Message and tap WhatsApp: that is safe, because you choose no chat and press no send.

🔁 If you have tested Business Manager before on this phone, erase its data before step 1: the round “?” in the bottom corner → “🧹 Start fresh — erase this app’s data” → OK → OK. The setup only fills the price list when it is empty, so otherwise your old prices stay and several steps will not match. A short setup may be offered after the welcome tour, four questions you answer by tapping. Unless a step tells you to try it, tap “No thanks, just open it”.

steps.do: When the app opens, a “Welcome to Business Manager” card is at the bottom. Tap the small link “skip the tour” at its bottom-right.
steps.see: A card asks “How do you want to start?” with “🧪 Keep the examples to play with” (it mentions Kiprono Builders) and “✨ Start fresh with my own”.
steps.tip: A green greeting may show at the top for a few seconds — it goes away by itself. A purple “Test copy” pill means you are in a safe test copy.

steps.do: Tap “🧪 Keep the examples to play with”.
steps.see: An example business opens: “Kiprono Builders” at the top, a note “This is an example business. Play with anything.”, “Good morning/afternoon/evening, Joseph.”, Owed to me KES 6,500, a Paid this month amount (it depends on today’s date, so any figure is fine), and a “NEEDS YOU (7)” list.
steps.tip: Look around if you like, but do not press “Remind”, “Send” or “Check in” — they open a text message.

steps.do: Scroll to the top and tap “Start my own business” in the example note. On the next screen, tap “Next →” without typing anything.
steps.see: A “Set up · about two minutes” chat asks “First: what’s your business called, and what’s your name?” with two boxes. Tapping Next with them empty shows a box: “What’s the business called? (Your own name is fine.)” — tap OK and you stay on the question.
steps.tip: 🔁 TESTED THIS APP BEFORE? Erase it first, or steps 9, 10, 13 and 14 will not match. Tap the round “?” in the bottom corner → “🧹 Start fresh — erase this app’s data” → OK → OK. The setup only fills the price list when it is EMPTY, so on a second run your old prices stay and the ten building prices this script needs are never put in. That would be our mistake, not yours.

steps.do: Type the business name in the first box and your name in the second box (both below), then tap “Next →”.
steps.see: It asks “What do you need, Peter?” with “🧾 Just quotes (Quick Quote)” and “🧰 The whole business” — the second one already shows “✓ Picked”.
steps.tip: If you leave the app halfway through the setup and come back, tap “Set it up for my business” again: since v1.6 (11 November) your answers are kept and it carries on where you stopped. Before that, leaving the app lost them. Frank found this on 11 November.

steps.do: Tap “🧰 The whole business”.
steps.see: “Good to meet you, Peter. What kind of work do you do?” with 14 buttons, including “🏗️ Building & Construction”.

steps.do: Tap “🏗️ Building & Construction”.
steps.see: “How should customers reach you? This goes on your estimates and invoices.” with Phone, Email and Town and street (optional).
steps.tip: Your button may read “🏗️ Building & Construction” (the Kenya edition) — tap that one. Same job, different name.

steps.do: Type the phone and email below into the first two boxes and tap “Next →”.
steps.see: Your answer shows as a bubble, and the next question is “Before you start a job, do customers usually get a price in writing?” with three answers.

steps.do: Instead of answering the rest, tap “Skip — turn everything on” at the bottom-right. Read the list, then tap “Let’s go →”.
steps.see: “All set, Peter. Here’s what I turned on for you:” — Estimates, Itemized prices, Deposits & progress billing, Schedule, Job costs, Crew & hours, Expenses & profit, To-do & due dates, Invoices with your M-Pesa details and reminders — and “I started your price list with typical building & construction prices.” After Let’s go: “Otieno Builders” at the top, “Good evening, Peter.” (or morning/afternoon), Owed to me KES 0 and “✅ All caught up. Nice work.”
steps.tip: A short tip “Tip: tap + to add your first job” shows at the bottom for a moment.

steps.do: Tap ⚙️ More (bottom-right), then “🏷 Price list” (it says 10 items).
steps.see: Ten rows with a price each: Site supervision (per day) 3,500, Fundi labour (per day) 1,500, Casual labour (per day) 800, Stone walling, machine-cut (per m²) 2,800, Plastering & rendering (per m²) 450, Gypsum ceiling, supply & fix (per sq ft) 130, Concrete slab (per m³) 15,000, Materials (at cost) 0, Rubble removal by lorry (per trip) 8,000, Concrete mixer hire (per day) 3,500.
steps.tip: Does it say a different number of items, or is there no Plastering & rendering row? Then this app still has your list from a previous run. Go back to the top of this script and do the erase in step 3's tip first. The item names are cut off on a small phone — tap a name box and move along it to read the rest.

steps.do: Find the row that starts “Plastering & rendering (per m²)”. It has two boxes and a red ✕: the wide box on the left is the name, the small box on the right that says 450 is the price. Tap that small box, delete the 450 and type the number below, then tap on the empty area above the list.
steps.see: A green “Saved ✓” pill shows briefly. The Plastering row’s price box now says 500.
steps.tip: Do not touch the ✕: it removes the whole row.

steps.do: Tap the round yellow “+ New” at the bottom, then “👤 New customer”. Type the name, phone and address below (leave Email empty) and tap “Save customer”.
steps.see: Wanjiru Njoroge’s page: her phone and address, buttons 📞 Call, 💬 Message, 📍 Map, “Paid you, all time KES 0”, “No jobs yet.” and “➕ New job for Wanjiru”.
steps.tip: Do not press Call or Message — they open your real phone.

steps.do: Tap “➕ New job for Wanjiru”. The Customer box already says Wanjiru Njoroge. In “What’s the job?” type the first part below, in Details type the second part, then tap “Save job →”.
steps.type: Plastering and ceiling · Plaster the kitchen walls (about 40 m2) and fix a gypsum ceiling in the sitting room, about 120 sq ft.
steps.see: The job page: “Plastering and ceiling” with “#1001 · Wanjiru Njoroge”, a “New” label, your details, and under PRICE / ESTIMATE “No price yet.” with “⚡ Draft from my price list”, “✨ Ask my AI”, “➕ Add item” and Total KES 0.
steps.tip: Do not press “📨 Send the estimate” or “📨 Send estimate”.

steps.do: Tap “⚡ Draft from my price list”.
steps.see: Three lines appear, each marked “📌 price list”: Rubble removal by lorry (per trip) KES 8,000, Plastering & rendering (per m²) KES 500 and Gypsum ceiling, supply & fix (per sq ft) KES 130. Total KES 8,630. Note: the draft puts 1 of each — it does not pick up the “40 m2” from your details, and it added rubble removal you did not ask for.

steps.do: Tap the Rubble removal line and tap “Remove”. Then tap the Plastering line, change “How many” to the number below and tap “Save”. Then tap “➕ Add item”, tap “Concrete mixer hire (per day) KES 3,500” and tap “Save”.
steps.see: Plastering shows “40 × KES 500” and KES 20,000; Gypsum ceiling KES 130; Concrete mixer hire KES 3,500; Total KES 23,630.

steps.do: Scroll down a little and tap “👍 They said yes”. The box already says Wanjiru Njoroge and today’s date — tap “Mark approved”.
steps.see: A brief note “Approved. Next: pick a day.”, the label at the top now says Approved, and the estimate shows “✅ Approved by Wanjiru Njoroge on” today’s date.
steps.tip: The “Approved. Next: pick a day.” note shows for only a moment. If you miss it, the Approved label and the ✅ line are enough.

steps.do: Scroll down to BILLING and tap “Deposit (30%)”.
steps.see: “Invoice #2001” for Wanjiru Njoroge: KES 7,089, “still owed · Deposit”, “Not sent”, and one line “Deposit — 30% of Plastering and ceiling (KES 23,630)”.
steps.tip: Do not press “📨 Send invoice with M-Pesa details”.

steps.do: Tap “💵 Record a payment”. The amount already says 7089. Change “How” to Cash and tap “Save payment”.
steps.see: A note “Deposit received 👍”; the invoice says “paid in full · Deposit”, Balance due KES 0, and under PAYMENTS: today, Cash, KES 7,089.
steps.tip: The “How” box has M-Pesa, Bank transfer, Cash and Other — pick Cash.

steps.do: Tap 💵 Money at the bottom. Then tap “➕ Expense”, type the amount and the store below, choose the job “Plastering and ceiling — Wanjiru Njoroge” under the job box, and tap “Save”.
steps.see: Before: Money in KES 7,089, Profit KES 7,089. As you type Nakuru Hardware the kind changes to “Materials & supplies” by itself. After saving: Money out −KES 3,200, Profit KES 3,889, “Set aside about KES 972 for income tax”, and under JOB BY JOB: Plastering and ceiling, KES 20,430, 86% kept.

steps.do: Tap 🏠 Today, then “📝 To-do”. Type the to-do below, pick a date 3 days from today, tap “Add”. Then tap “📋 Add common due dates — KRA, vehicle, insurance, permits” and “Add the ticked ones”. Finally tap the round ○ next to the gypsum boards to-do.
steps.type: Order gypsum boards for the Njoroge ceiling
steps.see: First “THIS WEEK (1) · Order gypsum boards for the Njoroge ceiling · Due in 3 days”. Then “Added 5 due dates”, including Turnover Tax return & payment (by the 20th), PAYE, SHIF, NSSF & Housing Levy (by the 9th) and Annual income tax return on iTax (by 30 June), each with its next due date (the dates move with today’s date). Tapping ○ shows “Done ✓” and the gypsum to-do moves out of the list.

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload. If a “What would you like to do?” page shows, tap “Pick up where I left off”. Tap 🏠 Today, then 🧰 Jobs.
steps.see: Everything is kept: Today shows “Otieno Builders”, Paid this month KES 7,089; Jobs shows “Plastering and ceiling · Wanjiru Njoroge · KES 23,630 · Approved”, and the to-do list still has the tax dates.

steps.do: Tap “⚙️ More” at the bottom, then “👥 Customers”, then “Wanjiru Njoroge”. On her page tap “💬 Message”.
steps.see: A message box opens with words already written to Wanjiru. Under it: “📨 Text it”, then “💬 WhatsApp”, then “📋 Copy”. There is no Email button, because Wanjiru’s email was left empty.
steps.tip: The 💬 emoji moved from Text it to WhatsApp — Text it is now 📨. The small print under the row should mention WhatsApp.

steps.do: Tap “💬 WhatsApp”.
steps.see: WhatsApp opens with the message to Wanjiru already typed in, and asks which chat to send it to. Pick nothing and come back. Close the message box, tap ⚙️ More and scroll to the very bottom: it says “Business Manager v1.6 · 2026-11-11”. That’s the end — thank you!
steps.tip: If WhatsApp is not on this phone, a WhatsApp web page opens instead and asks you to install it — that still counts as working. A number saved without the +254 country code cannot be dialled straight into WhatsApp, so it asks you which chat — that is expected.

steps.do: Now the videos. This app has 3. Open each one and watch it right through, sound on: Explain it to me — https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/watch.html?app=businessmanager&mode=firsttime  Watch it work — https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/watch.html?app=businessmanager  Train me — https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/watch.html?app=businessmanager&mode=train
steps.see: Each one talks without stopping — no long silences, no sentence starting again. The screen behind the words changes to match what is being said, and when it points at something, that thing is really there. If a video talks about a button or a screen you did not see in this app, say so — that is a real fault and one of the most useful things you can find.

steps.do: Last, the shop page everyone sees before they buy: https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/ — find this app on its shelf and read its card.
steps.see: The name and the one-line description match the app you just used. The price says Free, with an optional donation to Loving InDeed. That is right: nothing is sold, and nobody has to give. Nothing on the card promises something the app does not do. If the card and the app disagree, the card is the fault — say which bit.

steps.do: Tap the ? button at the top right, then tap “Make it mine”. If it shows “Set it up now”, tap that and answer the four questions by tapping. (If you already answered them when the app first opened, tap “Answer them again”.)
steps.see: Four questions, one at a time, each answered with one tap. At the end it says “Done — that is yours now”. Say whether the questions made sense for this app, and whether any answer you wanted was missing.

steps.do: Tap ? then “Make it mine” again, then tap “✨ Make it mine — ask for something”. Ask for one report you would really want from this app, in your own words. Answer its questions.
steps.see: It asks you a few short questions, then builds a report. Tell us: did the questions make sense, and is the report something you would actually use? If it cannot make one, write down exactly what it said.

steps.do: Tap into any box where you type (a name, a note, a to-do). Look beside the box for a small round 🎤 pop-up. Then tap the 🎤 on your phone’s keyboard and say a few words. Do it three times in a row. If this app has no box to type in, skip this step and say so.
steps.see: No floating round 🎤 button sits beside the box, and the keyboard’s 🎤 writes your words all three times, not just the first or second. A few apps have their own 🎤 button built into the screen (Feedback Studio, Rafiki, One Thing, Business Manager, In My Own Words). That is meant to be there. A fault is a floating 🎤 beside a box, or the keyboard 🎤 stopping after one or two tries. If it stops, tell us which time, and your phone (iPhone or Android).
